description: Binding contribution validates the bound type and scope: the bound type must be unambiguous (exactly one super type), the same type may not be bound twice, and all scope-defining annotations must agree.

cases.expected_output:
status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=The bound type could not be determined for Impl. There are no super types.

sources:
package com.example

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.ContributesBinding
import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Inject

interface Base
interface Base2

@Inject
@ContributesBinding(Unit::class)
class Impl : Base, Base2

cases.expected_output:
status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=The bound type could not be determined for Impl. There are multiple super types: Base, Base2.

status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=All scopes on annotations must be the same.
